features.name: Summoner Spellcasting
features.description:
Your link to your eidolon grants you limited magic connected to your eidolon's nature. You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a summoner, when you cast spells, your incantations call upon forces related to the spellcasting tradition determined by your eidolon, and your gestures often echo the shape of the rune that you and your eidolon share.

Each day, you can cast one 1st-rank spell. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots. As you increase in level as a summoner, the magical link with your eidolon grants you additional spell slots per day, as well as higher ranks of spells. Your total number of spell slots and the highest rank of spells you can cast are shown on the Summoner Spells per Day table. Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are, or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Charisma, your spell attack modifier and spell DC use your Charisma modifier.

When you gain spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast it in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up— this is usually equal to the highest rank of summoner spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level summoner, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level summoner, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

features.name: Spell Repertoire
features.description:
The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn one 1st-rank spell of your choice and five cantrips of your choice. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your eidolon, or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot (see the Summoner Spells per Day table), you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell. At 3rd level, you add the first 2nd-rank spell to your repertoire. At 4th level, you gain your second 2nd-rank spell, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already have so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot or vice versa.

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out link spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

features.name: Link Spells
features.description:
Your connection to your eidolon allows you to cast link spells, special spells that have been forged through your shared connection with your eidolon. Link spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to specifically connect with your eidolon, such as by having a heart-to-heart conversation, playing together, or meditating in unison on the nature of your bond.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots; you can't cast them using spell slots. Certain feats give you more focus spells. The maximum Focus Points your focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus spells you have, but can never be more than 3 points. The full rules for focus spells appear here.

You learn the evolution surge link spell, which allows you to grant your eidolon one of several useful benefits.

Link cantrips are special link spells that don't cost Focus Points, so you can cast them as often as you like. Link cantrips are in addition to the cantrips you choose from your tradition's spell list. Generally, only feats can give you more link cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, you can't swap out link cantrips gained from summoner feats at a later level, unless you swap out the specific feat via retraining. You learn the boost eidolon link cantrip, which briefly improves your eidolon's capabilities, allowing them to attack with greater power.

features.name: Evolution Feat
features.description: Evolution feats are a special type of summoner class feat that allow you to customize your eidolon through your shared link. You select one evolution feat for your eidolon at 1st level, representing the differences that make them unique from other eidolons of their type. If you retrain this feat, the feat you replace it with must also be an evolution feat.

classes.description: You can magically beckon a powerful being called an eidolon to your side, serving as the mortal conduit that anchors them to the world. Whether your eidolon is a friend, a servant, or even a personal god, your connection to them marks you as extraordinary, shaping the course of your life dramatically.

feats.name: Advanced Weaponry
feats.description: Your eidolon’s attack evolves. Choose one of your eidolon’s starting melee unarmed attacks to gain one of the following traits, chosen when you gain the feat: disarm; grapple; nonlethal; shove; trip; or versatile B, P, or S.

feats.name: Arcane Fists
feats.description: Your physical training encompasses unarmed combat forms. The damage die for your fist changes to 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don’t take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attacks. Your unarmed attacks gain the arcane trait, making them magical. At 5th level, you also gain the critical specialization effects of unarmed attacks in the brawling group and weapons in the brawling group, using your spell DC instead of class DC.

feats.name: Backup Runic Enhancement
prerequisites: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
feats.description: While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental runic magic. You can cast the sigil cantrip as an innate spell at will. In addition, choose either runic body or runic weapon. You can cast this spell once per day as an innate spell. The rank of these spells is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least trained in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine).

feats.name: Death Speaker
feats.description: Your voice and magic speak to the core existence within undead creatures, circumventing the need for the creature to comprehend. Your spells and abilities ignore the mindless trait and any immunity to emotion, fear, or mental effects when targeting or affecting undead creatures. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you attempt to Make an Impression on and make a Request of an undead creature.

feats.name: Dual Studies
feats.description: You and your eidolon learn different skills. Choose two skills. Your eidolon becomes trained in one of those skills, and you become trained in the other skill. At 7th level, you each become an expert in the chosen skills. Unlike other skill proficiencies, these proficiencies are not shared between you and your eidolon.

feats.name: Energy Heart
feats.description:
Your eidolon’s heart beats with energy. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. One of their unarmed attacks changes its damage type to the chosen type, and they gain resistance to that type equal to half your level (minimum 1).

Dual Energy Heart, Energy Resistance

feats.name: Engraving Strike
feats.description: You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target at the moment of impact. Make a melee Strike with the weapon. On a success, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike

feats.name: Expanded Senses
feats.description: Your eidolon evolves more acute senses. Your eidolon gains low-light vision and darkvision, as well as scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

feats.name: Expressive Face
feats.description:
Your face is constructed to move organically and show your emotions, making you more relatable to organic creatures. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you are already trained in Diplomacy, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain the Glad-Hand skill feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites.

Enhancement You are particularly skilled at pouring your heart out to others. You gain the Plaintive Plea action.

Plaintive Plea [single action] (fortune) Frequency once per day; Effect You make an emotional appeal to convince someone during a diplomatic encounter. If your next activity is to attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression or Request, or to attempt to influence a creature during an influence encounter, you can roll twice and take the better result.

feats.name: Extend Boost
feats.description: You can increase the duration of your eidolon’s boosts. You learn the extend boost link spell.

feats.name: Glider Form
feats.description:
Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent. They glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as they spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, they remain in the air at the end of your turn.

Airborne Form

feats.name: Glyph Familiar
feats.description:
You have taken a living rune as a familiar to aid you in your adventures. You gain a familiar. You choose one familiar or master ability per day instead of two, but your familiar also always has three additional familiar abilities: construct, flier, and tough.

Enhanced Glyph Familiar

feats.name: Magus's Analysis
feats.description: You make an assessment informed by your knowledge of how a creature fights. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature, then recharge your Spellstrike. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check if you previously hit the creature with a Strike this turn. The subject of your check is temporarily immune to Magus’s Analysis for 1 day.

feats.name: Meld Into Eidolon
feats.description:
Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon. You Manifest your Eidolon, but instead of summoning them into an adjacent open space, you become them. You can also Meld into Eidolon while your eidolon is manifested in an adjacent space. While Manifested in this way, you use your eidolon’s statistics, and you can’t act except to direct the eidolon to use Manifest an Eidolon to unmanifest themself. Your eidolon is affected by boost eidolon while Manifested in this way.

Since you can’t act, you can’t cast spells, activate or benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, perform actions that have the tandem trait, or use other abilities that require you, and not the eidolon, to act. You can’t be separately targeted while you are melded into the eidolon. When you reach 0 HP, your eidolon unmanifests, leaving your body behind, unconscious and dying.

feats.name: Messenger
feats.description:
You were built with a special ability to relay private messages to your fellow automatons, but you can luckily use it with anyone you would like. You gain message as an innate arcane cantrip.

Enhancement You can target up to five creatures at once when you cast message.

feats.name: Powerful Tail
feats.description:
You resemble an animal or a type of humanoid who has a tail. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This tail is in the brawling group.

Enhancement Your tail is not only powerful but also flexible. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet, and you reduce the number of free hands required to Climb or Trip by one.

feats.name: Raise a Tome
feats.description:
You can flip open a book to simultaneously study and deflect attacks. When you Raise a Shield, you can raise a book you’re wielding instead of a shield. While you have a book raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks to identify creatures using a skill related to the subject of the book (Arcana if you’re using your spellbook). If consulting the book normally grants an item bonus to the check for consulting the book, you gain this bonus as well.

If you have Shield Block, you can use a raised tome for that feat as though it were a shield. The tome has Hardness 3, HP 12, and BT 6.

In addition, you can inscribe the reinforcing rune into your spellbook to strengthen your tomes, using the same process as transferring a rune. The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. The rune’s benefits apply to any one tome in your possession chosen during your daily preparations. If your spellbook leaves your possession, the rune-granting benefit is suppressed until you get the book back.

Shielded Tome

feats.name: Reach of the Dead
feats.description: You channel your necrotic magic through a thrall, expending it in the process. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has range, you cast that spell from one of your thralls within 60 feet. That thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell; calculate range and cover from its space instead of yours. The thrall is then destroyed.

feats.name: Remote Detonation
feats.description: You whisper an invocation over your ammunition as you shoot it, and the hissing of the projectile sounds just like your murmured voice. Make a ranged Strike that uses physical ammunition against a target within the first range increment of your weapon. If it hits, you Invoke Runes on the target as whisper of the ammunition’s flight sets off the runes. You can invoke up to two runes this way, but all the runes must be on the target of your Strike. On a critical hit, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on any saving throws against the runes invoked by your Remote Detonation.

feats.name: Rune Ward
feats.description: You quickly sketch a rune in the air to gain a modicum of protection against the triggering magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw and AC against the spell.

feats.name: Rune-Singer
feats.description:
You practice the lost art of using music to guide your runecarving, singing the runes into existence as much as crafting them. You can use Performance instead of Crafting when attempting Crafting checks related to runes.

Once per 10 minutes, you can Trace a Rune with song alone. When you do, you use the 2-action version of Trace Rune as a single action without needing an artisan's toolkit, and you remove the action's manipulate trait. You don't need to be able to move your hands when Tracing a Rune using song, but you do need to be able to sing in a clear voice.

Prodigal Rune-Singer, Song of Glorious Invocation

feats.name: Seek the Hidden Glyphs
feats.description:
You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps. Even if you aren’t Searching, you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. As long as you are holding or wearing an artisan’s toolkit, you can use Crafting instead of Thievery to disable a magical trap, treating your proficiency in Crafting as your proficiency in Thievery for requirements.

In addition, if you trigger a trap by critically failing a check to Disable it, you can Trace a Rune on yourself as a reaction, gaining the benefits of the rune before the trap affects you.

feats.name: Smithing Weapons
feats.description: Though you are an artisan, you are well versed in using the tools of your trade to fend off enemies. While wielding a weapon in the hammer, knife, and pick weapon group, you can use that weapon to etch runes without an artisan's toolkit. Additionally, a Strike with a hammer, knife, or pick deals 1 additional fire damage to an enemy bearing one of your runes as sparks fly on impact like a hammer to an anvil.

feats.name: The Hallowed Dead
feats.description:
While many necromancers seek unholy and perverse power, you have dedicated yourself to the practice of necromancy to stop the creation of permanent undead and the corruption of souls. You and your thralls gain the holy trait. Strikes your thralls make gain the holy trait and deal 1 additional spirit damage. This additional spirit damage increases to 2 at 10th level. You also gain the following anathema: “purposefully create undead to do undue harm.”

Hallowed Earth

feats.name: The Unholy Dead
feats.description:
You have turned your necromancy against the divine powers that seek to stop you from achieving your unholy goals. You and your thralls gain the unholy trait. Strikes your thralls make gain the unholy trait and deal 1 additional spirit damage. This additional spirit damage increases to 2 at 10th level. You also gain the following anathema: “destroy undead of no harm to you.”

Corrupted Ground

feats.name: Undead Familiar
feats.description:
You gain the ability to raise an undead familiar who will serve you as your loyal and sometimes expendable partner as you explore your necromantic magic. You gain a familiar. It has the undead trait instead of the animal trait and is immune to bleed, death effects, disease, mental, and poison. You can choose only one familiar ability per day for this familiar instead of two, and you can’t choose an ability that changes the creature’s trait (such as construct or dragon). Additionally, this familiar can be targeted by spells and abilities that target your thralls. If you destroy your familiar, you can raise them back to undeath during your next daily preparations.

Enhanced Undead Familiar

feats.name: Undead Hunter
feats.description:
You were created by a Nexian mage specifically for the purpose of fighting undead, and you are infused with vitality magic. You gain vitality lash as an innate divine cantrip.

Enhancement You can infuse your attacks with vitality. You can cast infuse vitality as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, targeting only yourself.

feats.name: Unfetter Eidolon
feats.description: You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side. You learn the unfetter eidolon link spell.

feats.name: Widespread Fascination
feats.description:
You are not content to restrict yourself to one field. Instead, you've studied a wider range of necromantic magic to better expand your horizons and explore your unscrupulous fascinations. You learn the grave spell for a grim fascination other than yours. You must have access to that fascination. Access can be gained from independent study or sought-out tutelage.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different grave spell each time.

spells.name: Animal Allies
spells.description:
You summon tiny, ordinary animals from the environment, such as insects, birds, or fish, to quickly lash out at nearby foes. The animals swarm around the creatures in the area, dealing 3d4 piercing damage to each creature with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 3d4.

spells.name: Approximate
spells.description:
Your magic quickly flows over an area to help you count and catalog. Name a particular type of object you're looking for within the area. You gain an instant estimate of the quantity of the chosen objects that are clearly visible within the target area. The number is rounded to the largest digit. For example, you could look at a pile of 180 copper coins, and you would learn that it held about 200 coins, but you couldn't determine there were exactly 180 coins.

The type of object you name can be as specific or general as you like—“dented copper coins” is as viable as “coins”—but the distinguishing features must be obvious at a glance, and the spell is fooled by objects disguised as other objects.

spells.name: Artistic Recollection
spells.description: You touch your finger to a blank surface and create an image of a person, place, or object. This image appears instantly in the style of a pastel-hued oil painting and disappears cleanly once the spell ends. The portrait is the size of one average sketchbook page and must represent a subject the caster has seen in person or has studied extensively.

spells.name: Biting Words
spells.description:
You entwine magic with your voice, causing your taunts and jibes to physically harm your enemies. You can attack with your words once when you finish Casting the Spell, and can repeat the attack once on each of your subsequent turns by taking a single action, which has the attack, concentrate, and linguistic traits. After your third attack total, the spell ends. When you attack with biting words, make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within 30 feet, dealing 2d6 sonic damage if you hit (or double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Blessing of Vigor
spells.description:
You pray for a small blessing to keep your target safe. The target gains fast healing 3.

Heightened (+1) The fast healing increases by 3.

spells.name: Bone Shield
spells.description:
You create an expendable shield of rough, raw bone in a free hand that can easily be replaced over and over again. When you Cast the Spell or the first time each round you Sustain this spell on subsequent rounds, you can Raise this Shield, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. While this spell is in effect, you gain the Shield Block reaction, but only with the bone shield. The bone shield has Hardness 3 and 1 HP (with no Broken Threshold). This shield also gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its Hardness against attacks that deal piercing or slashing damage. If the shield is destroyed, it's recreated already raised in a free hand when you Sustain the Spell.

Heightened (+2) The shield’s Hardness increases by 3.

spells.name: Breadcrumbs
spells.description:
You protect your target from going astray in hostile territory by tracking where they've already been, helping the target deduce where they still need to go. The target leaves a glittering trail behind them that lasts for the spell's duration. This trail doesn't denote the direction or the order of its path—it merely indicates where the target has moved during the spell's duration.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to last until your next daily preparations.

spells.name: Cinder Scribe
spells.description:
Conjuring a quill of magical flame, you take an object and write a message onto it that disappears to the naked eye almost as soon as you finish writing it. If this message is written onto an object that can't withstand a burning fire, such as paper or leather, then the object is destroyed while you're writing it. If the inscribed object is thrust into a roaring fire, the writing on it is revealed for 1 minute before fading. The writing can be revealed this way any number of times, and it's erased only if it's counteracted by an effect similar to dispel magic or when the duration ends. Even if the object is destroyed, pieces of the message exist on its various parts. For example, if the object was turned to dust and recreated via remake, the message would remain intact.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to a year and a day.

Heightened (4th) The duration is unlimited.

spells.name: Cradle Aloft
spells.target: 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
spells.description: You temporarily release gravity's hold on an object, allowing you to let go of it without dropping it to the floor. The object floats next to you in your space, following you if you move. You can Interact to retrieve the object on your turn as a free action. If you're within reach of another creature, that creature can spend a single action with the attack trait to attempt an Athletics check against your spell DC, retrieving the object out of the air on a success. The creature must have a free hand to attempt this check. The spell ends if a creature successfully retrieves the object. If the object is floating when the spell ends, it falls.

spells.name: Create Earthen Facsimile
spells.description: You hold a clump of soil, and it morphs into a small figurine in your hand. The soil transforms and hardens into a simple form of your choosing. While it does hold its shape if undisturbed, the figurine is brittle and will crumble under pressure or turn back to mush at the end of the spell's duration.

spells.name: Decompose
spells.description:
You touch a corpse to speed up the decaying process. The target begins to rapidly decompose. After a day, any organic material will be gone, and after a week, any trace of the target will be gone.

Heightened (3rd) Organic material is gone within a minute, and any trace of the target is gone within an hour.

spells.name: Dome of Tranquility
spells.description:
The air around you falls still and blocks out the sounds of the outside world. While you can clearly hear anything within this isolated dome, you can't hear anything outside of it. The opposite is also true, with no one outside of your dome being able to hear what's within. This dome doesn't block line of sight. If anything larger than 1 Bulk passes through it, the dome is automatically dispersed. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (5th) The duration increases to 24 hours.

spells.name: Echoing Weapon
spells.description:
You channel energy into the target weapon, and the air around it faintly hums each time it strikes a blow, as the impact is absorbed into the weapon. If a creature is wielding the weapon at the end of its turn, the weapon discharges a burst of sound targeting one creature adjacent to the wielder. The sonic damage dealt is equal to the number of successful Strikes with the target weapon that the wielder made that turn (to a maximum of 4 sonic damage if the wielder hits with four Strikes).

Heightened (+2) The sonic damage increases by 1 per Strike (and the maximum damage increases by 4).

spells.name: Fishing Spot
spells.description: You conjure a fishing rod and an extraplanar pool teeming with fish. After 10 minutes of fishing, you catch a magical fish; roll 1d8 to see which fish you caught and the effects gained from eating it once it's cooked. The fish must be cooked and eaten (a process that takes about 30 minutes) within 1 hour of being caught, and the listed effect lasts for 1 hour after consumption. Each fish can feed only a single creature. Musical trout +2 status bonus to Performance checksPrimordial bass +2 status bonus to Survival checksGhoulfish +2 status bonus to Intimidation checksBurbling barbel +2 status bonus to Deception and Diplomacy checksDashing dace +2 status bonus to Acrobatics checksVigocarp +2 status bonus to Athletics checks to Climb and SwimAggressive perch +2 status bonus to Athletics checks to Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, and TripScholar salmon +2 status bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge

spells.name: Gravitational Pull
spells.description:
By suddenly altering gravity, you pull the target toward you. The target is pulled 10 feet closer to you unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. On a critical failure, it's also knocked prone. The effects of this spell change depending on the number of actions you spend when you Cast this Spell.

[single action] The spell targets one creature. [two actions] (concentrate) The spell targets one creature and pulls the target 20 feet instead of 10. [three actions] (concentrate) The spell targets up to five creatures.

spells.name: Groom Companion
spells.description: Companions can easily become covered in blood, dirt, and other nasty substances, creating a poor impression in noncombat situations. When you Cast this Spell, you immediately clean your companion, trim their fur or nails as appropriate, and leave them smelling nice. Additionally, future dirt, grease, grime, and other nasty substances slide off the target, keeping them clean and groomed. Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Performance checks. At the GM's discretion, your companion might be able to gain admittance to an establishment that wouldn't normally allow beasts for the duration of this spell.

spells.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
spells.description:
You gather magical energy into your palm, forming a concentrated ball of electricity that crackles and rumbles like impossibly distant thunder. Make a ranged spell attack roll against your target's AC. On a success, you deal 3d6 electricity damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and is dazzled for 1 round. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its range as well as other parameters.

[two actions] This spell has a range of 30 feet. [three actions] This spell has a range of 60 feet and deals half damage on a failure (but not a critical failure) as the electricity lashes out and jolts the target.

Two Rounds If you spend 3 actions Casting the Spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. After attacking the target, whether you hit or miss, the ball of lightning explodes, dealing 2d6 electricity damage to all other creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the target (basic Reflex save). Additionally, you spark with electricity for 1 minute, dealing 1 electricity damage to creatures that Grapple you or that hit you with an unarmed Strike or a non-reach melee weapon.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage on a hit, as well as the burst damage for 2-round casting time, each increase by 2d6, and the damage creatures take if they Grapple or hit you while you’re in your sparking state increases by 1.

spells.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
spells.description: With enchanted gusto, you encourage yourself to get things done and share your motivation with your allies. You gain a +1 status bonus to your choice of attack rolls, Will saves, or Charisma-based skill checks. During the spell’s duration, an ally who observed you Casting this Spell and was within 30 feet when you did so can take a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to gain the same bonus you chose until the start of their next turn. Using this spell to influence someone in a social situation is typically considered a faux pas, negating the benefit on Charisma-based skills if the subject of the check observed you casting the spell.

spells.name: Juvenile Companion
spells.description:
You transform your companion into its juvenile form, such as a cub, foal, kitten, puppy, or piglet, making the target appear small and harmless. It becomes Tiny (if it was larger), and its reach is reduced to 0 feet. All its Speeds are halved (to a minimum Speed of 5 feet), and it gains weakness 5 to physical damage. In all other ways, its abilities and statistics are unchanged. If your companion uses a hostile action, juvenile companion ends. This spell has no effect on a companion that doesn't have a juvenile form.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 1 hour.

spells.name: Lose the Path
spells.description:
You surround a moving creature with lifelike illusions, shifting their perception of the terrain to subtly lead them off course. The target must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result, the creature is immune to lose the path for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature treats all squares as difficult terrain for its Stride.

Critical Failure As failure, except that you determine where the target moves during the Stride, though you can’t move it into hazardous terrain or to a place it can’t stand.

spells.name: Metal Merged
spells.target: one metal weapon you are wielding
spells.description: You call forth the metal that flows through your veins, welding it together with the weapon you wield. For the duration of this spell, you can’t drop your weapon, and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to Disarm you.

spells.name: Musical Accompaniment
spells.description:
You’re surrounded by orchestral music that shifts and changes to match your behavior. This music provides a +1 status bonus to Performance checks. At the GM’s discretion, it provides this bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks as the music changes to support you in social situations, though some creatures are unaffected by such obvious attempts to use music to elicit specific emotions. This music moves with you and has a maximum volume equal to four humans shouting. You take a –4 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks while the music is playing. You can’t control the exact music this spell creates, and the music doesn’t create intelligible words or singing. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 10 minutes.

spells.name: Necromancer's Generosity
spells.description:
You channel void energy through your magical connection to your undead minion to strengthen the creature. The target regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell, and it gains a +2 status bonus to saves against vitality effects for the duration.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.

spells.name: Nudge the Odds
spells.description:
You bestow yourself supernaturally good luck at cards, dice, and other games of chance. You gain a +1 status bonus to Games Lore checks to gamble, and if you roll a critical failure on such a check, you get a failure instead; however, the spell is too short-lived to use for Earn Income checks from gambling. When you're under the effect of nudge the odds, one facial feature, such as a lock of hair or the iris of an eye, transforms to a distinctive golden color; the GM chooses which feature when you Cast the Spell. This change resists all magical efforts to conceal it, though it can be hidden or covered by mundane means. A creature noticing the feature can identify the spell using Recall Knowledge. Because it prevents losing big, gamblers consider nudge the odds a repugnant form of cheating. If you're caught using the spell, you're likely to suffer serious consequences depending on the nature of the gamblers you cheated.

Heightened (5th) The status bonus increases to +2, and the duration increases to lasting until the next time you make your daily preparations. If you continue spending your spell slot each day to keep the duration active, this allows you to apply the effect to a downtime check to Earn Income.

spells.name: Propelling Air Stream
spells.duration: until the end of your next turn
spells.description:
You shoot out a high-speed blast of air that propels you into the air. Make a ranged spell attack against a target’s AC. On a success, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage (or double damage on a critical hit). Regardless of whether you hit, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Protect Companion
spells.target: your eidolon, or a creature with the minion trait under your control
spells.duration: until the start of your next turn
spells.description:
You extend your aura as a magical shield that protects your eidolon or minion. The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You gain the following reaction; after using the reaction, the spell ends and you can't cast protect companion again for 10 minutes.

Life Block [reaction] Trigger The spell's target would take damage;Effect Reduce the triggering damage by 10, but you lose 5 Hit Points. Even if this reduces the damage to 0, the target still takes any effects that would come with the damage, such as the poison on a viper's fangs Strike.

Heightened (+2) The reaction reduces the damage by another 10, and you lose 5 more Hit Points. If you want to lose fewer Hit Points, you can choose to lower the damage reduction and HP lost to what any lower-rank version of the spell could do without lowering the spell’s actual rank.

spells.name: Pyroclastic Truth
spells.description:
This impossible spell is more devious and insistent than most. While all impossible spells long to be used, this spell relentlessly urges those who learn it to destroy everything in their path. The blast of liquid fire created by this spell brands the soul of those who are touched by its flames, dealing 2d12 fire damage to all creatures, structures, and unattended objects in the area. All creatures damaged by this spell are marked by fire for the duration of the spell. When you Fuel Pyroclastic Truth, all creatures marked by fire take 1d12 persistent fire damage.

Lethologic Mark You understand the true desire of fire to burn away your soul. Whenever you take fire damage, you become frightened 1. Additionally, if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points by a fire effect, you instantly die and are turned to ash, and your soul is cast into the Plane of Fire to burn for eternity. To heal this mark, you must perform an atone ritual in both the Plane of Fire and the Plane of Water.

Heightened (+1) The initial fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage increases by 1d12.

spells.name: Quick Sort
spells.target: up to 200 unattended objects in range, each of light Bulk or less
spells.description:
You magically sort a group of objects into neat stacks or piles. You can sort the objects in two different ways. The first option is to separate them into different piles depending on an easily observed factor, such as color or shape. Alternatively, you can sort the objects into ordered stacks depending on a clearly indicated notation, such as a page number, title, or date. The objects sort themselves throughout the duration, though it takes less time per object to sort a smaller number of objects, down to a single round for 30 or fewer objects.

Heightened (3rd) The spell can sort up to 500 objects in a minute, or 75 objects in a round.

spells.name: Read the Air
spells.description: You survey a social situation, showing courtesy to all around you as your intuition swiftly picks up clues about social contexts and unspoken assumptions of behavior. Your body language subconsciously changes to take advantage of this information and use it in your own interactions with those creatures. As part of Casting this Spell, you Recall Knowledge using Society to gain information about the social situation. You also gain a +1 status bonus to your next Diplomacy check to Make an Impression on those creatures present when you Cast this Spell, as long as the check occurs during the duration of the spell. You can read the air only once in a given social situation; casting it again has no effect.

spells.name: Restyle
spells.target: 1 piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally
spells.description: You permanently change the appearance of one piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally to better fit your aesthetic sensibilities. You can change its color, texture, pattern, and other minor parts of its design, but the changes can’t alter the clothing’s overall shape, size, or purpose. The changes can’t increase the quality of the craftsmanship or artistry of the piece of clothing, but particularly gauche choices for the new color and pattern might decrease its aesthetic appeal. This spell transforms existing materials into the desired appearance and never alters the material or creates more material than what’s originally part of the object. The object’s statistics also remain unchanged.

spells.name: Seashell of Stolen Sound
spells.description:
You store a sound in a seashell to use as you will: the last words of a loved one, a dragon’s mighty roar, the compromising conversation between two powerful diplomats, or even something stranger and secret. As part of Casting this Spell, you must present an unbroken seashell. When you Cast the Spell, magic swirls around the triggering creature, copying the sounds it makes, as well as any background noise, for the next minute and storing them in the seashell.

You or another creature can then play the sound back from the seashell during the spell’s duration by Interacting with the seashell, but once the sounds have been played back, the seashell shatters, and the spell ends.

As normal for spells with a duration until your next daily preparations, you can choose to continue expending the spell slot to prolong the duration of an existing seashell of stolen sound for another day. While the spell faithfully copies the sounds around the target, it doesn’t reproduce any special auditory or sonic effects of the sound.

spells.name: Sky Sight
spells.description: You gaze up and see the sky clearly despite environmental conditions. You can see through weather and physical obstructions such as a forest canopy, building material, and cave walls. This can be used to spot flying creatures or navigate by the stars even when you otherwise couldn’t see them.

spells.name: Stick On
spells.description: The skin on your hand begins to ooze a strange adhesive that causes it to stick to a target. You and the target become inseparable for the spell’s duration or until the target Escapes. If the creature is smaller than you, it’s immobilized and pulled along with you as you move. If the target is the same size as you, you’re both pulled along with each other as either moves, but you both treat all spaces as difficult terrain. If the target is larger than you, you’re immobilized and pulled along as the target moves. You can Dismiss this spell.

spells.name: Synchronize
spells.description:
You harmlessly place your unique magic sigil in the shape of your choice, which is about 1 square inch in size, on your targets. When you Cast the Spell, you set the duration by choosing a time at which point the sigil flashes dimly three times. After that point, the spell ends. Even though spell durations aren’t normally exact, the effects of synchronize are precise to the second. The timer is based on the place where the spell was cast, so entering a plane or area where time flows differently changes how the time elapses in sometimes unpredictable ways.

Heightened (2nd) The spell can target up to 20 willing creatures.

spells.name: Tame
spells.description:
As you make comforting sounds and gestures, you approach the target in a friendly manner combining caution and confidence. You improve the target’s attitude to you by one step (unfriendly to neutral, neutral to friendly, friendly to helpful) for the duration of the spell unless it succeeds at a Will save. Afterward, the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

This spell works only on domesticated animals; for example, you could use it on guard dogs or stray dogs but not feral dogs or wolves. If the socialization of the animal is in question, the decision is up to the GM.

Heightened (3rd) The duration becomes 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) The duration becomes 1 hour.

spells.name: Thicket of Knives
spells.description: You create numerous phantom copies of your weapon arm, hiding your true movements and rendering your attacks unpredictable. You gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks. If you’re untrained in Deception, you can use the Feint action anyway as well as add your level as your proficiency bonus despite being untrained.

spells.name: Wash Your Luck
spells.description:
Some practitioners argue this spell literally washes your fortunes of all influences, malign or benign, while others claim it simply cleanses your mind of obsessions about luck and destiny. You adjust your garments, change the posture of your chair, fidget with a religious symbol, or make some other innocuous and personally significant action to wash away bad luck.

Once during the spell’s duration, before rolling a check, you can cancel out a misfortune effect on that roll, as normal when a fortune and misfortune effect apply to the same roll. After canceling out the misfortune effect, the spell ends, and you’re then temporarily immune to wash your luck for 10 minutes.

runes.name: Atryl, Rune of Fire
runes.usage: drawn on a creature or object
runes.description:
This rune is often placed on a stone in a hearth, its power ensuring the stone remains warm through the night. The bearer’s fire resistance, if any, is reduced by 5. Its immunities are unaffected.

Invocation The bearer takes 1d8 fire damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, it's also dazzled for 1 round.

Level (+2) The reduction in fire resistance increases by 1, and the damage of the invocation increases by 1d8.

runes.name: Baruiel, Rune of Hold's Bravery
runes.description:
This scratched rune reminds the bearer to stand strong against fear when near allies. As long as the rune-bearer is within 10 feet of one of its allies, whenever it would reduce its frightened condition by 1, it instead reduces it by 2.

Invocation The essence of the rune is released outward, easing the minds of others. Each ally of the rune-bearer within a 10-foot emanation reduces their frightened condition by 2.

runes.name: Camonica, Rune of Perplexity
runes.description:
This rune of looping swirls is difficult to look straight at and stirs up a psychic cacophony in a foe's mind. The first time each round the rune-bearer takes an action with the concentrate trait, the turmoil increases, dealing it 2 mental damage.

Invocation The cacophony fragments and expands rapidly in a mental explosion, dealing 1d4 mental damage to the rune- bearer with a basic Will save. On a failure, the rune-bearer is stupefied 1 for 1 round (or stupefied 2 on a critical failure).

Level (+2) The damage from the mental turmoil increases by 1 and the damage of the invocation increases by 1d4.

runes.name: Esvadir, Rune of Whetstones
runes.usage: drawn on a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage
runes.description:
This cuspate rune, when placed on a blade, ensures it won't go dull. Strikes with the weapon or unarmed attack deal an extra 2 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die.

Invocation A blast of cutting energy is released outward from the rune, dealing 1d8 slashing damage to a creature adjacent to the rune-bearer, with a basic Reflex save.

Level (+2) The damage of the invocation increases by 1d8.

runes.name: Holtrik, Rune of Dwarven Ramparts
runes.description:
Similarity in the Dwarven words for “wall” and “shield” ensure that this angular rune, once used to shore up tunnels, can apply equally well in the heat of battle. A creature that has the shield raised gains a +1 status bonus to AC.

Invocation You call the shield to its rightful place. You Raise the Shield bearing the rune, as if the rune-bearer had used Raise a Shield, and the shield's status bonus to AC lasts until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

runes.name: Ledria, Rune of Appeal
runes.description:
No matter what skin, shell, or scale this rune is drawn on, it shines like gold. The rune-bearer gains a +1 status bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Performance checks.

Invocation The rune draws creatures closer to the bearer. Each creature within 30 feet of the rune-bearer can Step closer to the rune-bearer as a free action.

Level (9th) The bonus increases to +2.

Level (17th) The bonus increases to +3.

runes.name: Lyskel, Rune of Frost
runes.usage: drawn on a creature or object
runes.description:
This rune is often placed on chests and boxes to keep their contents from spoiling, even in the hottest of climates. The rune-bearer takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds and becomes so cold that movement becomes dangerous; if the bearer takes a move action, it becomes clumsy 1 until the beginning of its next turn.

Invocation The rune-bearer takes 1d4 cold damage, with a basic Fortitude save. All squares on the ground in the bearer's space and adjacent squares are covered in snow, becoming difficult terrain for 1 round.

Level (+2) The damage of the invocation increases by 1d4.

runes.name: Marssyl, Rune of Impact
runes.usage: drawn on a weapon or unarmed attack that deals bludgeoning damage
runes.description:
This rune magnifies force many times over as it passes through the rune's concentric rings. The weapon or unarmed attack deals 1 bludgeoning splash damage per weapon damage die. If the rune is on a melee weapon or melee unarmed attack, you and the rune-bearer are immune to this splash damage.

Invocation The rune vibrates as power concentrates within it. The next successful Strike made with the weapon or unarmed attack before the end of its wielder's next turn deals an additional die of damage, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be pushed 10 feet away from the attacker (20 feet on a critical failure).

runes.name: Oljinex, Rune of Cowards' Bane
runes.description:
This rune resembles a broken arrow. The shield bearing the rune gains a +2 status bonus to its Hardness against physical damage from ranged attacks.

Invocation (illusion, mental, visual) The rune creates an illusion in the minds of all creatures adjacent to the rune-bearer that lasts for 1 round. The illusion is of a large, impassable wall blocking all paths away from the rune-bearer. Creatures affected by this invocation can't willingly move farther away from the rune-bearer for 1 round or until they disbelieve the illusion, usually by using a Seek action.

Level (+4) The status bonus to Hardness increases by 1.

runes.name: Pluuna, Rune of Illumination
runes.usage: drawn on a creature or armor
runes.description:
While many runes emit a faint glow, illumination is the focus of this simple rune. The rune sheds bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light to 40 feet). Creatures in the emanation take a –1 item penalty to Stealth checks.

Invocation Each creature in the light must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be dazzled for 1 round. The light fades, but the target still sheds dim light in a 20-foot emanation for 1 round.

runes.name: Ranshu, Rune of Thunder
runes.usage: drawn on a creature or object
runes.description:
This vertical rune is often carved on tall towers to draw lightning and shield the buildings below it. If the rune-bearer doesn't take a move action at least once on its turn, a small bolt of static finds it, dealing 3 electricity damage.

Invocation The preliminary streaks of lightning braid together into a powerful bolt. The rune-bearer takes 1d8 electricity damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Level (+2) The damage from the bolt of static increases by 1, and the damage of the invocation increases by 1d8.

runes.name: Rehgog, Rune of Bestial Might
runes.description:
The jagged edges of this rune evoke the claws and talons of mighty beasts. The target's nose becomes an animal-like snout, giving the rune-bearer scent as an imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

Invocation The rune-bearer's muscles bulge with the strength of a ferocious beast. The bearer can immediately Step as a free action. The next unarmed Strike the bearer attempts before the start of your next turn deals an additional die of damage.

runes.name: Sertum, Rune of Preparedness
runes.description:
The wavy lines of this rune evoke fields of reeds, the branches of trees blowing in the wind, or other natural phenomena. The rune-bearer gains a +1 status bonus to Survival checks and to Lore checks related to a type of terrain or specific natural location you choose as you draw the rune. The rune-bearer can use Survival to roll initiative, and the status bonus applies to this roll.

Invocation The rune reaches out to the surrounding terrain, shifting it to the rune-bearer's advantage. The rune-bearer can Step up to three times as a free action.

Level (9th) The bonus increases to +2.

Level (17th) The bonus increases to +3.

runes.name: Thullax, Rune of Corrosion
runes.usage: drawn on a creature or object
runes.description:
The swooping lines of this rune seem to melt into each other as if their edges were hazy and indistinct, though the meaning is clear to you. The rune-bearer's resistance to each physical damage type is reduced by 1 (if it has any such resistances). Its immunities are unaffected.

Invocation The bearer takes 1d6 acid damage with a basic Fortitude save; on a critical failure, it takes 1 persistent acid damage.

Level (+2) The reduction in physical resistance increases by 1, the damage of the invocation increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage increases by 1.

runes.name: Tilus, Rune of Vocabulary
runes.description:
Upon close inspection, this rune comprises hundreds of smaller characters of various runic languages. When you etch or trace this rune, choose one language you know. The rune-bearer can speak and understand the chosen language and gains a +1 status bonus to Society checks and to Lore checks related to writing (such as Library Lore and Scribing Lore).

Invocation The rune-bearer's voice rings clear and true, allowing them to automatically succeed at any flat check that could disrupt an auditory action (such as the one imposed by the deafened condition) for 1 round. During this time, the bearer can also speak their true mind even if they are currently confused, controlled, or otherwise unable to speak.

Level (9th) The bonus increases to +2.

Level (17th) The bonus increases to +3.

runes.name: Zohk, Rune of Homecoming
runes.description:
This circular mark allows travelers to always find their way home. The rune-bearer gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds, but only when its movement would end closer to you than where the creature started its turn.

Invocation (teleportation) You call the rune-bearer to your side. You teleport the target to any unoccupied square adjacent to you. If the bearer is unwilling, it must succeed at a Will save to negate the effect.

wizard-arcane-school.name: School of Breathtaking Influence
wizard-arcane-school.description:
Source Impossible Magic pg. 108

You have sway in powerful social circles and pride yourself on being able to predict and manipulate opponents. Less scrupulous academies openly teach this curriculum to aspiring politicians, while other colleges frame it as the study of countering mental manipulation. These spells are staples in Quantium, where ambition and ruthlessness are measures of success.

Curriculum - Cantrips: Daze, Infectious Enthusiasm - 1st: Command, Fear, Sleep - 2nd: Blood Vendetta, Phantom Crowd - 3rd: Enthrall, Mind of Menace - 4th: Confusion, Outcast's Curse - 5th: Subconscious Suggestion, Wave of Despair - 6th: Dominate, Never Mind - 7th: Contingency, Puppet Strings - 8th: Dream Council, Hidden Mind - 9th: Telepathic Demand

School Spells - Initial: Appeal to Authority - Advanced: Hot Air

wizard-arcane-school.name: School of Keen Inquiry
wizard-arcane-school.description:
Source Impossible Magic pg. 108

You’re a scholar of truth, seeking knowledge about the nature of existence and events past, present, and future. Whether you share or obfuscate that truth—best reserve judgment until you know what you’re working with. Quantium’s elite claim agents of Her Most Keen Eye, Nex’s network of spies, developed this curriculum, but it’s a staple in many politically oriented colleges.

Curriculum - Cantrips: Detect Magic, Sigil - 1st: Disguise Magic, Illusory Disguise, Mindlink - 2nd: Knock, See the Unseen - 3rd: Clairaudience, Locate - 4th: Clairvoyance, Detect Scrying - 5th: Mind Probe, Scouting Eye - 6th: Scrying, Truesight - 7th: Retrocognition, True Target - 8th: Disappearance, Pinpoint - 9th: Foresight

School Spells - Initial: Fact Check - Advanced: Unsettling Perspective

wizard-arcane-school.name: School of Nexian Spaces
wizard-arcane-school.description:
Source Impossible Magic pg. 108

Whether your goal is immortality or creating a world with every detail tailored to your liking, retracing Nex’s experiments with demiplanes is the road to achieving your desires. Your formal learning starts with reshaping your current reality and drawing power from other planes of existence. You graduate to creating extraplanar spaces and traveling between planes, making time and space yours to mold like clay.

Curriculum - Cantrips: Phase Bolt, Warp Step - 1st: Alarm, Pet Cache, Thoughtful Gift - 2nd: Dimensional Drop, Vanish Weapon - 3rd: Cozy Cabin, Far Reach - 4th: Flicker, Liminal Doorway - 5th: Banishment, Space Fold Gate - 6th: Collective Transposition, Proximal Shift - 7th: Interplanar Teleport, Planar Palace - 8th: Quandary, Stars of Another Sky - 9th: Resplendent Mansion

School Spells - Initial: Extradimensional Cover - Advanced: Unbounded Sphere

wizard-arcane-school.name: School of Quantic Control
wizard-arcane-school.description:
Source Impossible Magic pg. 108

You’re an architect, but not merely of buildings. You call upon elemental forces to control the building blocks of reality itself, reshaping the environment and moving creatures like the world is a diorama for you to perfect. Your curriculum draws heavily upon the experience of the geniekin of Quantium’s Wish, who maintain the infrastructure of Nex’s capital in seeming defiance of physics itself.

Curriculum - Cantrips: Gale Blast, Scatter Scree - 1st: Cradle Aloft, Gentle Landing, Pummeling Rubble - 2nd: Dismantle, Unrelenting Gravity - 3rd: Chosen Gravity, Inertia Lock - 4th: Containment, Living Terrain - 5th: Control Water, Wall of Stone - 6th: Repulsion, Wall of Force - 7th: Infinitesimal Collapse Field, Planar Seal - 8th: Arctic Rift, Earthbreaker Stride - 9th: Implosion

School Spells - Initial: Circle of Weakness - Advanced: Quantic Dampening
